checkpoint: Starts outside the Pokemon Mansion's door (8, 3) on (8, 4) facing south, where the Escape Rope out of the Mansion (13.04, pokeguy 1:20:24) leaves the player. 13.04 is authored separately; until it is in, this row's start is its own (starts_after_unauthored_rows()).

PokeGuy's way (1:20:37 to 1:21:43): all six quiz machines answered right, each opening the next door, so none of the gym's eight trainers is fought. Answers (pokefirered CinnabarIsland_Gym scripts.inc): 1 YES, 2 NO, 3 NO, 4 NO, 5 YES, 6 NO. A wrong answer starts the room's trainer instead; the table has no branch for that.
Every gym trainer has sight 0 (map.json trainer_sight_or_berry_tree_id): they fight only after a wrong answer or a talk, so no trainer lines here.

The doors are metatiles the quiz scripts swap (setmetatile in OpenDoorN); the map has them shut, one barrier tile each. Each is crossed by two plain steps with their ends declared, not a planned route. On the sim they need the door opened (no sim support yet: the test moves the player over them).
We heal at Cinnabar's Center first; pokeguy doesn't (he fights Blaine at 24/126 HP with one Surf each).
Ends in front of Blaine and saves there: his own pre-battle checkpoint (battle-checkpoint-retry), 14.02.
